== Notes ==
{{anomaly|This also converts [[chaos damage|chaos]], [[dark damage|dark]], [[holy damage|holy]] and [[Spirit|spirit attacks]] [[damage type]]s into earth damage.{{verify|Check whether this anomaly applies only to incoming damage for these types, or only to wanding damage for these types. Outgoing Holy spell damage is not converted, e.g. for the purpose of Intensity.}}}}
{{bug|This skill does not convert damage but instead forces the damage type of all dealt damage to be earth damage. For example when applying winter on top of stone striker, [[physical damage]] is not converted into [[earth damage]], since [[winter]] has no effect on it - it still considers the damage to be of physical type. This is irrespective of which damage converting skill is used first.}}
* While under this effect, outgoing attacks do not benefit from [[Conjure spells]] and (if melee) do benefit from [[Ebon Dust Aura]].
** This is the case even when conflicting damage type conversions are in effect, regardless of the order they are applied. Most other skills (such as [[Dust Cloak]] and [[Grenth's Fingers]]) use the most recently applied effect for this purpose instead.
* Good synergy with [[Mantra of Earth]] or [[Storm Chaser]].
* Consider using with [[Geomancer Insignia]], [[Earthbound Insignia]] and a [[shield]] or [[focus item]] with a [["Like a Rolling Stone"]] inscription.
